0.why: src/TL_Odd5.cpp:120 trig3.process(getVoltage()), Rack's default 0V/1V Schmitt thresholds

comment: The SPREAD parameter is configured 1 to 5 (TL_Odd5.cpp:91) although the comment beside the read at :105 says 0 to 9; the configured range is what is in force, so the outputs reach ±5V and never 0V of spread. The manual gives no figures for SPREAD or for the step knobs. The three jacks in each column carry no individual panel label, only TRIGGERS and SEQUENCES for the column; the top jack belongs to the three-step row, the middle to the five and the bottom to the seven, matching the order of the rows above. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic, and nothing in this plugin saves state, so the current step is not kept across a patch load.
